$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md). Channels are large public ones that the tests and the recon read. Tasks marked publish false stay saved but off the Store: the account publishes at most 100 pages across all actors, so each actor keeps 2 or more by its earnings and search traffic (2026-11-11).

tasks.name: export-telegram-channel-posts
tasks.title: Export Telegram channel posts to CSV, Excel or JSON
tasks.description: Download the newest 500 posts of a public Telegram channel with no login and no API key: text, date, views, reactions, photo and video links, files, links and the inline buttons under each post, one row per post. Replace durov with any public channel; @names and t.me links work too.
tasks.seoTitle: Export Telegram Channel Posts - CSV, Excel, JSON
tasks.seoDescription: Download every post of a public Telegram channel with no login: text, date, views, reactions, media links and buttons, ready for CSV, Excel or JSON.

tasks.name: telegram-channel-monitor-last-7-days
tasks.title: Telegram channel monitor: every post from the last 7 days
tasks.description: Collect every post several public Telegram channels published in the last 7 days, counted back from each run, so a daily or weekly schedule gives a rolling feed with views and reactions. Swap in the channels you follow; a span such as 24 hours is typed as 1 day.
tasks.seoTitle: Telegram Channel Monitor - Last 7 Days of Posts
tasks.seoDescription: Every post from the last 7 days of the public Telegram channels you pick, with views, reactions and media links. Schedule it for a rolling feed, no login.

tasks.name: telegram-media-links-scraper
tasks.title: Telegram media scraper: photo, video and file links per post
tasks.description: List the photo, video and file links of a public Telegram channel's posts, every album item included, with file names and sizes where Telegram shows them. Links point to Telegram's own servers, so download them soon after the run.
tasks.seoTitle: Telegram Media Scraper - Photo, Video, File Links
tasks.seoDescription: Get the photo, video and file links of a public Telegram channel's posts, album items included, with file names and sizes. No login, no API key.
